failure.message: verification command exceeded its effective deadline

cause: The dispatched JPEG request still carried the third (img2-w10) check inside the 600 s operator ceiling. img2-w8 and img2-w9 passed in 282.8 s and 261.5 s, leaving insufficient time for the third check, which then hit the remaining-deadline timeout. This is a caller request-composition defect: the intended split into two finite Gates had not been applied to the dispatched file.
repair: The unchanged JPEG definition is expressed with img2-w8 and img2-w9 only; the now-prior W10 suite is a separate finite Gate. No check argument, output, candidate or candidate binding changed.
replacement: Two explicit replacement Gates: JPEG (w8+w9) and W10 JPEG regression. No automatic retry; neither failed record is rewritten.
